ns0:section.ns0:heading: Implementation of a sentence of imprisonment

ns0:content.ns0:p: The implementation of a sentence of imprisonment is governed by the provisions of subchapter C of chapter 229 and, if the sentence includes a term of supervised release, by the provisions of subchapter A of chapter 229.

ns0:note.ns0:heading: Effective Date
ns0:note.ns0:p: Section effective Nov. 1, 1987, and applicable only to offenses committed after the taking effect of this section, see section 235(a)(1) of Pub. L. 98–473, set out as a note under section 3551 of this title.
